acceptance.evidence: The design and validation cover the reported unavailable HTML, failed zoom and dragging cost, with R/A identifiers and actual baseline causes. Earlier dated updates remain historical records.

Source defaults are four active instances per full view and sixteen per project; maxSurfaces still configures project-wide active count. Only creation 429 surface_limit and surface_retained_limit use the 500 to 5000ms backoff. Per-view capacity is an explicit error; retained surface count and frame-byte budgets are separately described. Authenticated presence counts all owner connections, waits 5s after the last departure, validates the full current identity and keeps short reconnect state. Normal non-persisted departure uses keepalive close; persisted events and hidden pages retain the source handler behavior. Bound annotation sources and durable PNGs retain their separate lifetime.

App reads native WheelEvent fields explicitly and advances wheelState synchronously; gesture controller handles relative native scale and touch midpoint/distance, cancellation, capture ownership and lifecycle resets. The three existing, twelve independent and one supplemental native-unit checks in gesture-review are passed; both P2 findings are closed. Documentation distinguishes actual WheelEvent getters and CDP contacts from synthetic WebKit/cache-event tests. Physical trackpad/touchscreen, Safari and real BFCache are explicitly unmeasured.

Renderer staging and copied source pixels are private fields. Content paint/text fields are strings and coordinates are finite; unknown/direct image sources use generic SceneFrame validation. Publish retains an origin-clean pixel copy and immutable metadata. Evidence copies displayed pixels synchronously at Done; the camera, CSS origin, DPR/bitmap dimensions and metadata remain paired. The independent report passes seven criteria, eleven Pattern-field negatives, six other negatives, 48000 channel comparisons across four DPR/camera cases and held N after six reuses plus resize. Both renderer findings are closed.

All before/final table entries were recomputed from retained original reports. Each final drag/pan has 59 exact matched inputs, no superseded or uncommitted input and zero long tasks. Main 2880x2000 readback disappears; source 1x1 origin checks remain. Raw registry IDs mapped to material names show no static image/Markdown/file/video publish, publisher creation or clear in final phases; GIF/HTML remain dynamic. Markdown useMemo depends on actual HTML text, and willReadFrequently preserves existing source-copy/origin and pixel sizing behavior.

CPU/RSS covers only owned frontend Chrome, excludes Node/CEF/other hosts and compositor display timing, and declares instrumentation, extra baseline stationary warmup, short-fixture and final focused-run boundaries. Earlier latency matcher, pan-tail failure and Firefox environment failure remain historical evidence.

The retained final default log reports 232 tests, 202 pass, 30 opt-in skips, zero fail/cancel, 93175.552625ms and exit 0 over 43 compiled test files. Private server/client typechecks and Vite build exit 0. 372 local links across five documents resolve, including anchors. Seven evidence JSON files parse.
